Name: Birthday Quest
Author: tsenre1
Description:
[size=5]Great mod if you always miss the birthday present friendship bonus (me).
[/size]
This mod reminds you when it's someone's birthday and adds 1-day "birthday gift" task to you quest board.
Optional loved gift hints within the quest.

e.g. on Spring 14 (Haley's birthday)...
[list=1]
[*]when you wake up, the game shows a dialogue box reminding you it's Haley's birthday[/*]
[*]adds a "birthday gift for Haley" limited time quest to your active quest log[/*]
[*](optional by config) shows Haley's loved gifts within the quest[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How can I enable loved gifts hint?[/b][/size]

You can enable it in the config. Config is located in BirthdayQuest/config.json.
Change the third line to:

[code]"LovedGiftsHint": true[/code]
[size=4][b]How can I enable schedule gifts hint?[/b][/size]

You can enable it in the config. Config is located in BirthdayQuest/config.json.
Change the fourth line to:

[code]"NpcScheduleHint": true[/code]
[size=4][b]Available config options[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]BirthdayNotification[/b]: shows a wake-up message when today is an NPC's birthday. Default: true.[/*]
[*][b]BirthdayQuest[/b]: adds a one-day birthday gift quest to your quest log. Default: true.[/*]
[*][b]LovedGiftsHint[/b]: adds a list of loved gifts to the birthday quest text. Default: false.[/*]
[*][b]NpcScheduleHint[/b]: adds the birthday NPC's schedule to the birthday quest text. Default: false.[/*]
[*][b]SkipUnknownNpcs[/b]: skips reminders and quests for NPCs you haven't met yet. Default: false.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) support (optional)[/b][/size]

If you have GMCM installed, you can edit config values within the GMCM menu.

[list]
[*]if on title screen: click cog button on bottom left -> click Birthday Quest[/*]
[*]if in game: esc -> click controller icon -> scroll to bottom -> click Mod Options -> click Birthday Quest[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Does this mod support other modded NPCs?[/b][/size]

Yes. Lmk if there are bugs/compatibility issues

Check out the code here if interested [url=https://github.com/ernfu/StardewBirthdayQuest]https://github.com/ernfu/StardewBirthdayQuest[/url].
I built this one caveman style (without AI) mainly for learning purposes.
